# 2mdn.net
> Google Marketing Platform and Campaign Manager 360 serving domain used for ad delivery, tracking, Floodlight, and rich media assets.

2mdn.net is primarily an infrastructure domain used by Google Marketing Platform products rather than a human-oriented documentation site. Useful context for LLMs comes from the official Google Marketing Platform, Campaign Manager 360, Display & Video 360, Search Ads 360, and Google Ads documentation that explains how 2mdn.net URLs, tags, redirects, creatives, and measurement are used.

## Campaign Manager 360 Help
- [Campaign Manager 360 Help Center](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager): Product help for trafficking, creatives, tags, tracking, and reporting.
- [Get started with Campaign Manager 360](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/topic/2837578): Introductory guidance for core Campaign Manager 360 workflows and concepts.
- [About creatives](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/topic/2826134): Explains creative types, hosting, serving, and management in Campaign Manager 360.
- [About tags](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/topic/2826142): Overview of ad tags, placements, redirects, and serving behavior.
- [About Floodlight](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/topic/2826132): Describes Floodlight activities, conversions, and measurement setup.
- [Reports in Campaign Manager 360](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/topic/2837570): Reporting concepts and report types for campaigns and creatives.

## Campaign Manager 360 Developer Docs
- [Campaign Manager 360 API Overview](https://developers.google.com/doubleclick-advertisers): Developer documentation for the Campaign Manager 360 API.
- [REST API Reference](https://developers.google.com/doubleclick-advertisers/rest): Reference for resources, methods, and schemas in the API.
- [Guides](https://developers.google.com/doubleclick-advertisers/guides): Implementation guidance for common Campaign Manager 360 API tasks.
- [Create and manage creatives](https://developers.google.com/doubleclick-advertisers/guides/trafficking_creatives): API guide for trafficking and updating creatives.
- [Create and manage placements](https://developers.google.com/doubleclick-advertisers/guides/trafficking_placements): API guide for placements, sites, and ad serving setup.
- [Manage Floodlight activities](https://developers.google.com/doubleclick-advertisers/guides/floodlight_activities): API usage for Floodlight configuration and related resources.

## Display & Video 360 Help
- [Display & Video 360 Help Center](https://support.google.com/displayvideo): Product help for programmatic buying, creatives, and measurement.
- [Get started with Display & Video 360](https://support.google.com/displayvideo/topic/27224): Introductory material for advertisers and campaign setup.
- [Creatives in Display & Video 360](https://support.google.com/displayvideo/topic/6184964): Guidance on creative formats, assets, and serving.
- [Tracking and measurement](https://support.google.com/displayvideo/topic/6023705): Help content for measurement, verification, and conversion tracking.
- [Inventory and targeting](https://support.google.com/displayvideo/topic/6184967): Explains inventory sources and targeting configuration.
- [Reports in Display & Video 360](https://support.google.com/displayvideo/topic/27223): Reporting tools and metrics for campaign analysis.

## Display & Video 360 API
- [Display & Video 360 API Overview](https://developers.google.com/display-video/api): Developer documentation for DV360 automation and integrations.
- [REST Reference](https://developers.google.com/display-video/api/reference/rest): Resource and method reference for the DV360 API.
- [Guides](https://developers.google.com/display-video/api/guides): Guides for authentication, advertisers, line items, and creatives.
- [Manage creatives](https://developers.google.com/display-video/api/guides/managing-creatives): API guide for creating and updating creatives.
- [Generate and download reports](https://developers.google.com/display-video/api/guides/reports): Guide for report creation and retrieval through the API.
- [Structured Data Files](https://developers.google.com/display-video/api/guides/sdf): Documentation for bulk trafficking with Structured Data Files.

- [About conversion tracking](https://support.google.com/sa360/topic/9280412): Explains conversion measurement and attribution in Search Ads 360.

- [Reports and reporting columns](https://support.google.com/sa360/topic/1260808): Help for reporting metrics, columns, and analysis.
- [Search Ads 360 Reporting API migration](https://developers.google.com/search-ads/reporting): Developer docs for the modern Search Ads 360 API.

## Google Ads and Rich Media Standards
- [Google Ads Help Center](https://support.google.com/google-ads): Help for ad serving, tracking templates, and creative policies.
- [About tracking templates and URL options](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/6305348): Explains click tracking and URL parameter handling.
- [About third-party click tracking](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/2375447): Guidance on supported click trackers and redirect behavior.
- [Ad requirements and asset specifications](https://support.google.com/google-ads/topic/1626336): Creative format and asset requirements across ad types.
- [HTML5 ad requirements](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/1722096): Technical requirements for HTML5 creatives and hosted assets.
- [Image ad policies](https://support.google.com/adspolicy/topic/1626336): Policy guidance relevant to served image creatives and assets.

- [Training and certification](https://support.google.com/marketingplatform/topic/9475438): Official learning resources for GMP products.

## Google Tag and Floodlight Implementation
- [Google tag platform help](https://support.google.com/tagmanager/topic/15191151): Documentation for Google tag behavior and deployment concepts.
- [Tag Manager Help Center](https://support.google.com/tagmanager): Help for implementing tags, triggers, and variables.
- [Set up Campaign Manager 360 Floodlight tags](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2823222): Instructions for implementing Floodlight tags for conversion tracking.
- [About Floodlight counting methods](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2823221): Explains standard, unique, and session counting approaches.
- [Use Google Tag Manager with Floodlight](https://support.google.com/tagmanager/answer/6107160): Guide for deploying Floodlight tags through GTM.
- [Consent mode overview](https://support.google.com/tagmanager/answer/10718549): Consent-aware tagging behavior for Google measurement tags.

## Policies, Privacy, and Security
- [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy): Core privacy policy governing Google products and services.
- [How Google uses information from sites or apps](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites): Explains data collection on partner properties using Google technologies.
- [Advertising Policies Help](https://support.google.com/adspolicy): Policy center for ads, creatives, and restricted content.
- [EU user consent policy](https://www.google.com/about/company/user-consent-policy/): Consent requirements for using Google advertising and measurement products.
- [Authorized Buyers and OpenRTB policies](https://support.google.com/authorizedbuyers/topic/2913775): Programmatic policy guidance relevant to creatives and ad serving.
- [Google Ads Data Processing Terms](https://business.safety.google/adsprocessorterms/): Contractual data processing terms for advertising products.
